entry.description: stop a Telnet client that connects and then stops reading from suspending all logging. `TelnetAppender` writes to its clients while the appender lock is held and set no `Socket.SendTimeout`, so once TCP flow control filled the client's receive window the next write blocked forever and every thread logging through the appender queued behind it (CWE-833). Writes now time out after `SendTimeoutMillis` (5000 by default) and the client is disconnected; 0 restores the previous unbounded behavior (audit 1231d72-f001)
